remarks: Welcome to 1 Strawberry Hill Avenue, a highly sought-after and impeccably maintained building in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers an ideal combination of modern comfort and unbeatable location.Step inside to discover gleaming hardwood floors, a brand-new in-unit washer and dryer, and a spacious living area that opens to an expansive, private screened-in terrace-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The terrace features outdoor lighting and overlooks lush greenery, creating a peaceful retreat in the city.Enjoy access to premium amenities including a 24/7 doorman, a well-equipped gym, a resident library, a gorgeous outdoor swimming pool ideal for lounging or laps, and both a dedicated storage unit and additional same-floor storage. This unit includes a reserved underground garage parking space, and the building is known for its quiet atmosphere and safe neighborhood environment.Conveniently located just minutes from the Metro North station, UCONN, Stamford Hospital, top-rated restaurants and bars, and the vibrant weekend farmers market. You're also right by the entrance to I-95-making commuting a breeze.Don't miss your chance to live in one of Stamford's premier residences with everything you need at your doorstep!
